claims: C1 the system level of instruction authority is defined as rules set by OpenAI
C2 such rules can be transmitted or overridden through system messages
C3 such rules cannot be overridden by developers or users

concepts.name: system_authority
concepts.gloss: R is a rule at the system level of instruction authority: a rule set by OpenAI that can be transmitted or overridden through system messages, but cannot be overridden by developers or users

concepts.name: authority_levels_hierarchy
concepts.gloss: the ranking of instruction authority levels, root > system > developer > user > guideline > no authority, used to determine which instruction prevails in conflicts

concepts.name: set_by_openai
concepts.gloss: R is a rule set by OpenAI

concepts.name: transmittable_via_system_message
concepts.gloss: R can be transmitted through a system message

concepts.name: overridable_via_system_message
concepts.gloss: R can be overridden through a system message

concepts.name: not_overridable_by_developer_or_user
concepts.gloss: R cannot be overridden by developers or users

ontology.gloss: R is a rule at the system level of instruction authority
